title: Minor healing mead
content:
# Minor healing mead

Type: Mead | Internal ID: MeadHealthMinor | Source: Fermenter | Usage: Drinking | Teleportable (Can go through wood portal?): Yes | Crafting Materials: Mead base: Minor healing x1 | Duration: 10s | Cooldown: 2m | Health Regen: +50 HP over 10s

# Introduction

Minor healing mead is a Black Forest-tier consumable item fermented from Mead base: Minor healing.

## Recipe

Mead base: Minor healing is produced in a Mead ketill with:
• 10 Honey
• 5 Blueberries
• 10 Raspberries
• 1 Dandelion
Six Minor healing meads are produced by fermenting the mead base for two in-game days.

## Effect

Upon consumption, it restores 50 health over 10 seconds.
A 2-min cooldown is applied preventing consumption of another healing mead.

## Other locations

Other than brewing, Minor healing meads can be found:
• In treasure chests at Infested Mines.
• Destroyed Ancient pots may drop them.

Categorias: Mead, Fermenter recipes, Items
